data_fields.name: zone_bed_sound
data_fields.donor_constant: sound id from ruleset key 'ambience' (no fixed number)

data_fields.name: stereo_clamp
data_fields.donor_constant: clamp to +/- half the view width

best_idea: Give each zone a looping ambience bed (sound id and volume as zone data) on a fixed reserved channel, scale it by the master volume, and pan one-shots by camera-relative position with the sweep clamped to 80 degrees so no speaker goes silent.
decision_why: The per-zone bed with its own volume and channel is the zone-as-data shape Frankendom wants, but the donor has no crossfade and a hard-cut music change, so the browser build adds gain ramps and keeps the 80-degree clamp.
acceptance: Entering a zone starts its bed within one frame with no restart if it is already playing; crossing from zone A to zone B fades A out and B in over a data-set time (a test asserts both gains move monotonically with no step); a one-shot hit at the far left of a 375-wide view is panned at the clamped 80-degree limit, not fully left.
